name: Market
definition: Context or geographic environment in which trading parties execute trades.

GeographicalEnvironment.name: Geographical Environment
GeographicalEnvironment.definition: Geographic zone in which the cash transfer is executed, from the perspective of the forwarding or first agent, eg, domestic or international.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Jurisdiction of the governing law for the trades on this market, for example, City of NY, County of NY, State of NY, regulatory SEC.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country in which a market operates.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the market by name, id and/or code.
